hailReplies.label: Read them the charter: stand down, or be boarded under it.
Put it to a vote: every relay in the fleet jams theirs.
Read their losses into the open record. Every name.

nemeses.name: Inquisitor-Adjunct Seraphine Vael
nemeses.title: The Auditor
nemeses.tactic: Final Tally keeps her bow on you and fires the Audit Lance down it. Get out of her fore arc before it fires.
nemeses.hailFirst: Long Promise. You are carrying four hundred and eleven persons not entered in any ledger. I am here to correct the ledger.
nemeses.hailEscaped: You cost me {scar}. It has been entered against your name, with interest. Shall we settle?
nemeses.hailStandoff: An inconclusive result. I have never filed one before. I do not intend to file a second.
nemeses.hailFinal: The audit closes today. Final Tally does not withdraw, and you will not be given the chance.
nemeses.epitaph: The audit is closed. Nobody in the Ascendancy will be told how it balanced.
nemeses.retortEdict: You read me a charter. I have audited charters. They burn at the same temperature as everything else.
nemeses.retortFire: Unprovoked fire on an officer of the Inquisition. Entered. Signed. Carried forward.
nemeses.retortBoard: You jammed my relay by committee. How many of you did it take to agree?
nemeses.retortSilence: No statement. The record will show you had the opportunity.
nemeses.retortTaunt: You have published my deficit. No auditor leaves a ledger in that state. I will remain.

nemeses.name: Lictor-Captain Dorn Achter
nemeses.title: The Scourge
nemeses.trait: Relentless: Clean Hand fires two turns in three, and she is fast.
nemeses.tactic: Clean Hand and her Blades come straight in and shoot only forward. Turn them: a Blade that has to come about is a Blade that is not firing.
nemeses.hailFirst: A ship that votes. I have executed captains for less than asking. Yours asks everybody.
nemeses.hailEscaped: You gave me {scar}. I had the crew responsible spaced. Then I came to thank you in person.
nemeses.hailStandoff: You would not close and I could not catch you. One of us was a coward. I have had mine shot.
nemeses.hailFinal: No signal to withdraw has been loaded. I had the codes burned. Run out your guns.
nemeses.epitaph: Clean Hand's crew were found at their posts. They had not been given leave to abandon ship.
nemeses.retortEdict: Boarded under your charter. Come and board me. Bring all forty delegates.
nemeses.retortFire: Finally. Somebody on that ship who does not need a second.
nemeses.retortBoard: My Blades cannot hear me. They do not need to. They know what I would say.
nemeses.retortSilence: Quiet. I have had quieter crews. I had them shot too.
nemeses.retortTaunt: You show my ship her own wound. Good. Now she will not let me leave either.

nemeses.name: Vat-Master Ioun Rell
nemeses.title: The Shepherd
nemeses.trait: Shepherd: launches two darts at a time and calls Joint Fire.
nemeses.tactic: Tithe of Nine hangs back and spends darts. Kill them as they launch, or go through them for the vat-ship.
nemeses.hailFirst: I grow four hundred a week. I will spend all of them on you and be whole again by the end of the month. Can your Council say the same?
nemeses.hailEscaped: You left me {scar}, and took two hundred of mine. I have regrown them. I gave them your ship to hate.
nemeses.hailStandoff: We spent the same and neither of us bought anything. I can afford that. You cannot.
nemeses.hailFinal: The vats are empty and every one of them is in the air. There is nothing left to save, so I am not leaving.
nemeses.epitaph: The vats will be relit. It will be a month before anything walks out of them.
nemeses.retortEdict: Stand down? They would not know how. I never grew that into them.
nemeses.retortFire: You fire on children. Mine are nine days old. I will make more.
nemeses.retortBoard: You have cut me off from them. They will be so frightened. That is on you.
nemeses.retortSilence: You will not even speak to me. They always spoke to me, in the vats.
nemeses.retortTaunt: You read them their names. They never had names. Now I have to stay and explain.

relics.name: Vael's Seal
relics.text: +1 command on the first turn of every battle.

relics.name: Reef Charts
relics.text: Both rival fleets move a little slower on every jump.

relics.name: The Lost Compass
relics.text: Mined lanes cost the fleet nothing.
